scope.summary: Reads over tables with autonomous FGA handlers are refused before execution (fga_handler_autonomous); FGA evidence is proven from ALL_AUDIT_POLICIES with successful-empty admitting and query failure refusing (fga_evidence_unknown); local SYS-owned objects are proven FGA-free (ORA-46399 on DBMS_FGA.ADD_POLICY against SYS.DUAL, live FREE23); in-process harnesses answer FGA probes truthfully; W4 FGA canary cases (b3f3f360, 0f618dea, 555864bd, 4e1c7f13).
out_of_scope: Files changed again after the gate by later beads (catalog_query.rs, catalog_resolver.rs, dispatch/mod.rs, read_executor.rs, dispatch/tests.rs, guard lib.rs) are excluded from the clean-scope claim; their state at 5b5b93f7 is covered by the gate.
An operator override for accounts without FGA catalog visibility is an open operator decision (not part of this bead).
